claims: As of April 6, 2026, rapper Offset is in stable condition.
Rapper Offset was shot in the leg outside the Seminole Hard Rock Hotel & Casino in Hollywood, Florida.
Two individuals were detained following the shooting around 7 p.m.
The suspect(s) who fired the shots have not been publicly identified.
The incident occurred at the valet area of the Seminole Hard Rock Hotel & Casino in Hollywood, Florida.
A spokesperson confirmed Offset is "fine" and receiving medical care.
Seminole Police immediately secured the scene.
The investigation into the specific shooter and motive is still ongoing
